Fence Agent I/O by runnable lease generation

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: FWN-51
  description: |-
    Revalidate the durable send permit against current dispatch and runnable-lease authority immediately before Codex, Cursor, and Grok runtime mutations. Reject delayed workers whose lease generation, dispatch fence, phase, request, state, or permit expiry is no longer current, and cover the stale-generation boundary with a zero-external-call regression test.
